tcg/FreeRealmsTCG.dll default card service port 17782 (host.svr ghost/gport); the 15 starter archetypes are in storage.dat and the client's default.cln collection (T825).

duel.game_types: AccountCommand_RecordSinglePlayerGame (class 487, writer 10010300) names the game type: 3 Skirmish, 2 Scenario, 1 Tutorial (setter 1000ff10, game-screen setup 104ab920 / game-over handler 104ae280). The DLL plays those games itself (its own rules engine and AI), so a win is the client's report.

L935 (R): the lobby type and role, the 60 s pacing floor between a start record and a paying win, and the 25-coin purse are server choices, not recovered values; the Card Duelist activity_xp (466) is job_xp_curve.json's. A server-hosted NPC deck needs a rules engine this repo does not have, so a row here is credited by a Skirmish or Scenario win after launching it.

prizes_source.evidence: fanbyte wiki, Category:Trading Card Game (FR): defeating an NPC's deck wins 3 cards from that player, once per deck.

(R) lab/tools/card_prizes.py: a deck whose client text promises a Hero card pays that owner's Hero; the rest are picked from the deck's card series, seeded by its row. No source records the real cards.
